name: S1 Reference
desc: Dry roads, normal weekday demand, normal information spread. Vehicles inside tunnels held 15–40 min, then escorted out.

name: S2 Rain
desc: Wet roads: capacity −8 %, speeds −8 %, demand +3 % (more people drive).

name: S3 Snow / winter
desc: Snowfall: capacity −20 %, speeds −25 %, emergency vehicles slower, less mode shift (crowded platforms).

name: S4 Fast coordinated information
desc: VTS/police/Ruter push alerts within 4 min, 92 % reached, strong appeal to postpone trips / work from home.

name: S5 Slow / fragmented information
desc: Unclear messages, apps update after 25 min, only 55 % of drivers ever informed.

name: S6 Secondary collisions
desc: Rear-end collision on E18 Skøyen–Filipstad 08:40 (60 min, −60 % cap) and on Ring 2 Ullevål–Alexander Kiellands plass 09:30 (45 min, −50 %).

name: S7 Prolonged tunnel evacuation
desc: Vehicles inside tunnels are not allowed out (ventilation/lighting failure). Occupants evacuated on foot; stranded cars cleared after reopening (+30–60 min before full inflow).

name: S8 Active traffic management
desc: Police at key junctions and adaptive signal plans from 08:35 (+12 % arterial capacity), inflow metering on E18/E6/Rv4 entries, good info.

name: S9 High-demand day
desc: Demand +8 % (e.g. school start, event, Monday after holiday), otherwise as reference.

name: S10 Compound worst case
desc: Snow + slow information + secondary collision + vehicles held in tunnels for the whole closure.
